254:t_030:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「That's rare, $$竜馬$$. You, praising us.」

254:t_030:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Even he must've gotten a little scared, getting thrown out into a sea of stars.」

254:t_030:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Still running your mouths, I see. You've turned into old men, but you're still a pair of brats.」

254:t_030:4.en:
$$弁慶$$
「You bastard...! Thinking you're the only one who's a little younger!」

254:t_030:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「Leave him alone, $$弁慶$$. That seems to be the only thing he's got to be proud of.」

254:t_030:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What are you all doing?! We're in the middle of a battle right now!」

254:t_030:8.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Whoa! Miss $$スズネ$$ is mad at us!」

254:t_030:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You just wait, $$隼人$$! When this battle's over, I'm going to put you in your place before I start drilling $n!」

254:t_100:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wherever this is, I won't go easy on anything that attacks us!」

254:t_100:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's go! I'm getting back home fast, and I'll fight to protect the peace of Earth and my company's safe!」

254:t_101:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「To get back to Earth, we're winning this battle no matter what!!」

254:t_102:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's do it, $$マジンガー$$! Even out here at the end of space where not even sunlight reaches, you're the one who lights up the darkness!」

254:t_102:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「We'll never give up! We'll show the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s that!」

254:t_103:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
(...Something has been running through my body since a while ago...)

254:t_103:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
(Is this... a premonition of battle...!)

254:t_104:0.en:
$$タケル$$
(So this is the galactic sea... Where I was born...)

254:t_104:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(Why is it...? I feel like I can hear $$マーグ$$... my brother's voice from somewhere...)

254:t_105:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Fighting in places I don't know? I've been used to that ever since I left $$ジーハ村$$!」

254:t_105:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Out of the way, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! There's a woman waiting on Earth for me to come save her!!」

254:t_106:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$タカヤ・ノリコ$$ and $$ガンバスター$$ have fought our way through the sea of space...!」

254:t_106:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Come on, then, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! I'll knock you out of the sky, one by one!」

254:t_107:0.en:
$$葵$$
「A sea of stars this romantic, and my date turns out to be $$インベーダー#pilot$$s...」

254:t_107:1.en:
$$葵$$
「I don't want to see any more of your faces! So I'm cleaning you up, fast!」

254:t_108:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here you come, little $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! Not that I'm the least bit happy to see you!」

254:t_108:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「If you're coming at us, no mercy! We're not about to die before we get back to Earth, either!!」

254:t_109:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...Damn it! I haven't got time to deal with these fake $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$...!」

254:t_109:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We're going back to Earth! If you get in our way, we won't hold back!」

254:t_110:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I understand... I do understand! That you're the enemies of humanity! Because...!」

254:t_110:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ is the one who carries on the will of $$ノノリリ$$! A warrior who fights to protect the peace of Earth!」

254:t_111:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「No way I'm dying in a place like this! We've got a mountain of things to do back on Earth!」

254:t_111:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go! Wherever we are, it's hot-blooded justice straight ahead!!」

254:t_112:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, $$メール$$? If it's $$インベーダー#pilot$$s, there's no need to hold back, right?」

254:t_112:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then since I've got your OK, I'm going all out!!」

254:t_112:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Anyone who gets in the way of our trip back to Earth gets crushed by me and $$ガンレオン$$!!」

254:t_112:4.en:
$$メール$$
「Ah... I've got a feeling he's overdoing it...」

254:t_113:0.en:
$n
(I'm sorry, $$宗介$$... I couldn't save you and $$千鳥$$...)

254:t_113:1.en:
$n
(But it isn't over yet...! I... we will definitely return to Earth!)

254:t_113:2.en:
$n
(And then I'll do it...! I'll definitely rescue $$千鳥$$!)

254:t_114:1.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Identifying our current position will take a little more time.」

254:t_114:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Understood. But our resolve is already set.」

254:t_114:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We will return to Earth by any means necessary! Until then, whatever we face, we will show you we can survive!」

254:t_115:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I never thought I'd run into you two again in a sea of stars like this.」

254:t_115:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Quit complaining. We didn't come here because we wanted to, either.」

254:t_115:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「That's right. Let's take out this small fry quickly, then work out a way back.」

254:t_115:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Agreed! I'm even sicker of looking at these things than I am of your faces!」

254:t_116:0.en:
$$凱$$
「Not long ago we were fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ on Earth, and now we're suddenly smack in the middle of a sea of stars.」

254:t_116:1.en:
$$渓$$
「Quit grumbling, $$凱$$! With $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ and us, we can get through anything that comes!」

254:t_116:2.en:
$$號$$
「That's right, $$渓$$. Where there is hope, light is born.」

254:t_117:0.en:
$$グーラ$$
(The mass outbreak of $$バアル$$, starting with the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s... And the movements of that army...)

254:t_117:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
(Something is about to happen in space... Is that the sign of the universe's collapse that comes once every 12,000 years...)

254:t_117:2.en:
$$グーラ$$
(No... that's not it. I feel like something even bigger is about to happen soon...)
